screen.title: Conversation: A library replacement fee
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a librarian.

audio.text: I got a notice saying I owe ninety dollars for a book I lost. That seems like a lot for one book.
It's the replacement price plus a processing fee. But if you find a new copy of the same edition yourself, we'd only charge the processing fee, which is fifteen.
I've seen it online for about forty.
Then that's worth doing. Just make sure it's the third edition, not the newer one.

questions.stem: What does the librarian suggest the student do?
options: Pay the ninety dollars before the deadline
Look for the lost book in the library again
Ask the library to order a newer edition
Buy a replacement copy of the book himself

why.en: Detail (paraphrase of "if you find a new copy of the same edition yourself"). C is the trap: she warns him NOT to get the newer edition. A is what the notice says, not her advice.
why.tr: Ayrıntı ("if you find a new copy of the same edition yourself" ifadesinin parafrazı). C tuzak: daha yeni baskıyı ALMAMASI konusunda uyarıyor. A bildirimde yazan, onun önerisi değil.
why.es: Detalle (paráfrasis de "if you find a new copy of the same edition yourself"). C es la trampa: le advierte que NO compre la edición nueva. A es lo que dice el aviso, no su consejo.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the student's plan?
options: It will cost him less than paying the amount on the notice
It will cost him more than the notice because of the processing fee
The library will refund the forty dollars he spends
He will no longer have to pay any library fees

why.en: Inference with a calculation: about forty dollars for the book plus the fifteen-dollar fee is far less than ninety. D ignores the processing fee; B reverses the comparison; C is never mentioned.
why.tr: Hesaplı çıkarım: kitap için yaklaşık kırk dolar artı on beş dolarlık ücret, doksandan çok daha az. D işlem ücretini unutuyor; B karşılaştırmayı tersine çeviriyor; C hiç geçmiyor.
why.es: Inferencia con un cálculo: unos cuarenta dólares por el libro más la tarifa de quince es mucho menos que noventa. D olvida la tarifa de gestión; B invierte la comparación; C no se menciona.
